name: textract
description: Amazon Textract detects and analyzes text in documents and converts it into machine-readable text.

subcommands.name: analyze-document
subcommands.description: Analyzes an input document for relationships between detected items.

subcommands.name: analyze-expense
subcommands.description: AnalyzeExpense synchronously analyzes an input document for financially related relationships between text.

subcommands.name: analyze-id
subcommands.description: Analyzes identity documents for relevant information.

subcommands.name: create-adapter
subcommands.description: Creates an adapter, which can be fine-tuned for enhanced performance on user provided documents.

subcommands.name: create-adapter-version
subcommands.description: Creates a new version of an adapter.

subcommands.name: delete-adapter
subcommands.description: Deletes an Amazon Textract adapter.

subcommands.name: delete-adapter-version
subcommands.description: Deletes an Amazon Textract adapter version.

subcommands.name: detect-document-text
subcommands.description: Detects text in the input document.

subcommands.name: get-adapter
subcommands.description: Gets configuration information for an adapter specified by an AdapterId, returning information on AdapterName, Description, CreationTime, AutoUpdate status, and FeatureTypes.

subcommands.name: get-adapter-version
subcommands.description: Gets configuration information for the specified adapter version, including: AdapterId, AdapterVersion, FeatureTypes, Status, StatusMessage, DatasetConfig, KMSKeyId, OutputConfig, Tags and EvaluationMetrics.

subcommands.name: get-document-analysis
subcommands.description: Gets the results for an Amazon Textract asynchronous operation that analyzes text in a document.

subcommands.name: get-document-text-detection
subcommands.description: Gets the results for an Amazon Textract asynchronous operation that detects text in a document.

subcommands.name: get-expense-analysis
subcommands.description: Gets the results for an Amazon Textract asynchronous operation that analyzes invoices and receipts.

subcommands.name: get-lending-analysis
subcommands.description: Gets the results for an Amazon Textract asynchronous operation that analyzes text in a lending document.

subcommands.name: get-lending-analysis-summary
subcommands.description: Gets summarized results for the StartLendingAnalysis operation, which analyzes text in a lending document.

subcommands.name: list-adapter-versions
subcommands.description: List all version of an adapter that meet the specified filtration criteria.

subcommands.name: list-adapters
subcommands.description: Lists all adapters that match the specified filtration criteria.

subcommands.name: list-tags-for-resource
subcommands.description: Lists all tags for an Amazon Textract resource.

subcommands.name: start-document-analysis
subcommands.description: Starts the asynchronous analysis of an input document for relationships between detected items such as key-value pairs, tables, and selection elements.

subcommands.name: start-document-text-detection
subcommands.description: Starts the asynchronous detection of text in a document.

subcommands.name: start-expense-analysis
subcommands.description: Starts the asynchronous analysis of invoices or receipts for data like contact information, items purchased, and vendor names.

subcommands.name: start-lending-analysis
subcommands.description: Starts the classification and analysis of an input document.

subcommands.name: tag-resource
subcommands.description: Adds one or more tags to the specified resource.

subcommands.name: untag-resource
subcommands.description: Removes any tags with the specified keys from the specified resource.

subcommands.name: update-adapter
subcommands.description: Update the configuration for an adapter.
